{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in key columns
missing_values = sales_df[['customer_age', 'converted']].isnull().sum()

# Check min and max age for outliers
age_stats = sales_df['customer_age'].agg(['min', 'max', 'mean'])

# Check distribution of age for converted customers
converted_age = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age']
converted_age_stats = converted_age.agg(['min', 'max', 'mean', 'std'])

missing_values, age_stats, converted_age_stats"}
